title: Fix course code collision overwriting existing course and inheriting stale notebook_id
done_items: Identified exact root cause: folder name regex parsed semester prefix '115-1' as course code for both '115-1 心理學研究法' and '115-1 生涯諮商', leading to CourseRepository.save_course matching existing record and silently inheriting the previous course notebook_id without creating a new one. Created ISSUE-037.

history.summary: Fixed course code regex collision for semester-prefixed folders so new courses no longer overwrite existing courses or inherit stale notebook_id (commits 2bcd42a, f3fab5b, c9305b1; ISSUE-037)
